scope: Only literal canonical definitions and one Euclidean inner-product characterization statement without proof. No new-target proof/API recipe or prior reviewer verdict.

definitions.context: Set.range is the actual existential image; arbitrary real coefficient functions, not a supplied span/range certificate.
definitions.literal: def range (f : ι → α) : Set α := {x | ∃ y, f y = x}

definitions.context: Submodule namespace; fixed ℝ module of functions Fin d → ℝ. General context Semiring R, AddCommMonoid M, Module R M; no norm chosen by span.
definitions.literal:
def span (s : Set M) : Submodule R M :=
  sInf { p | s ⊆ p }

definitions.context: The ambient index m is finite. Fixed real scalar multiplication/addition in the target.
definitions.literal:
def dotProduct [Mul α] [AddCommMonoid α] (v w : m → α) : α :=
  ∑ i, v i * w i

definitions.context: Matrix namespace; NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α. Both fixed finite matrix multiplication and vector products use ordinary sums.
definitions.literal:
def mulVec [Fintype n] (M : Matrix m n α) (v : n → α) : m → α
  | i => (fun j => M i j) ⬝ᵥ v

definitions.context: Matrix namespace; decidable equality on finite indices, fixed real zero. Matrix powers are ordinary Nat powers in the canonical finite real matrix semiring, not entrywise powers.
definitions.literal:
def diagonal [Zero α] (d : n → α) : Matrix n n α :=
  of fun i j => if i = j then d i else 0

definitions.context: The literal constructor named toLp and projection ofLp identify the underlying values; this is not a norm-preserving claim about the raw function supremum norm.
definitions.literal:
structure WithLp (p : ℝ≥0∞) (V : Type*) where
  /-- Converts an element of `V` to an element of `WithLp p V`. -/
  toLp (p) ::
  /-- Converts an element of `WithLp p V` to an element of `V`. -/
  ofLp : V

definitions.context: PiLp 2 supplies the L2 product structure.
definitions.literal:
abbrev PiLp (p : ℝ≥0∞) {ι : Type*} (α : ι → Type*) : Type _ :=
  WithLp p (∀ i : ι, α i)

definitions.context: Fixed real scalars and finite indices. Actual norm and inner product in the consumer are those of EuclideanSpace, with WithLp.toLp shown explicitly.
definitions.literal:
abbrev EuclideanSpace (𝕜 : Type*) (n : Type*) : Type _ :=
  PiLp 2 fun _ : n => 𝕜

instance (p : ℝ≥0∞) {ι : Type*} (α : ι → Type*) : CoeFun (PiLp p α) (fun _ ↦ (i : ι) → α i) where
  coe := ofLp

context: local notation "⟪" x ", " y "⟫" => inner 𝕜 x y
definitions.literal:
theorem inner_eq_star_dotProduct (x y : EuclideanSpace 𝕜 ι) :
    ⟪x, y⟫ = ofLp y ⬝ᵥ star (ofLp x)
